title: Operations Coordinator
description: Coordinate daily operations, keep the team schedule, handle vendor and supplier relationships and track the monthly budget.

title: Customer Success Associate
description: Be the first contact for customers, resolve complaints, explain our products clearly and keep accurate records of every call.

title: Event and Community Coordinator
description: Organize customer events and festivals, negotiate with vendors, manage the event budget and lead a small team of volunteers.

title: Finance Assistant
description: Maintain the ledger and accounts in Excel spreadsheets, prepare budget reports and record payments on time.

title: Training Coordinator
description: Schedule training sessions, communicate with trainers and new joiners, mentor first-time learners and solve day-to-day problems.

title: Store Team Lead
description: Lead a team of store helpers, serve customers, negotiate better prices with suppliers and keep the stock register.

title: Project Coordinator
description: Track project deadlines, run weekly meetings, keep the project data in spreadsheets and communicate status to the team.

title: Data Entry Operator (part-time)
description: Accurate typing and data entry into records, finish daily batches on time, raise problems to the supervisor.
